source_decisions: Use d_i = A_i - B_i and one sample of differences; n counts complete pairs, s_d is the SD of the differences, and df = n - 1.
Adopt authored notation dbar and n in place of the original slides xbar_d and n_d.
The original slide 15 presents the zero-null test. Use the authored general null mu_(d,0), with zero identified as usual.
Original slide 14 visually displays n_d >= 30; slide 15 displays n > 30. Retain n >= 30 from slide 14 and the preceding series, as a course guideline, with influential outliers checked at every n.
Check independence across pairs, expected dependence within each pair, and the distribution of the differences. Use the authored sampling/assignment scope and finite-population caution.
No numerical example or source-data results were added.
